output.explanation: NIG-AU line NIG-AU:77558 accrues a USD 48,000 management fee for October 2026 with the reference ACCR-OCT26 and the note 'invoice not received', and counterparty NorthStar US resolves to NIG-US by master data. The two nearest unmatched NIG-US seller lines, NIG-US:4471026 (USD 9,900) and NIG-US:4471046 (USD 1,760), are secondment invoices with ratios of 0.2062 and 0.0367 to the target and no management-fee reference, so neither corresponds to this accrual.
output.recommended_action: NIG-US should confirm whether the October 2026 management fee has been invoiced or will be, and NIG-AU should keep the accrual for the period if the fee is confirmed or reverse it if no charge is due.
